subject.title: All .large bubbles should have scrollable body regardless of truncation

question: Should native long messages use nested per-bubble scrolling, or retain transcript scrolling and open through a dedicated full-message reader?
rationale: The request changes the primary mobile gesture model, and source inspection cannot determine which interaction maintainers want consistently across iOS and Android.

options.title: Use a full-message reader
options.body: Keep transcript scrolling primary and expose an explicit reader for long or constrained message content.

options.title: Add bounded bubble scrolling
options.body: Define a cross-platform large or tall threshold and place matching bubble bodies in bounded inner vertical scroll containers.

options.title: Keep transcript-only scrolling
options.body: Decline nested scrolling and retain the current interaction without adding a reader.

recommendation.title: Use a full-message reader
recommendation.body: Keep transcript scrolling primary and expose an explicit reader for long or constrained message content.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied issue history shows prior product-level review of this exact interaction request.
